## Hypothesis and configuration difference

## Dataset and labels

Use public or synthetic data with redistribution rights. Report missing labels and the exact
canonical-document unit. Keep the evaluation split fixed across variants.

## Results

Report each arm, union coverage, Recall@k, regressions, latency and actual model usage where relevant.
Separate retrieval recall from independent answer-quality assessment. Do not report a tiny demo as
production accuracy.

## Reproduction

Commands, provider/model versions, index recipe and limits. No secrets or private records.
